version_note: The initial axis definitions preceded computation. This version also documents the minimum peak-block cell count used during derivation and corrects the observed number of eligible G1 types; the reported G3 classifications use that refined rule.
scope: Five official T2 heart files, common measured 500 genes. One file per stage, descriptive effects only.

comparisons.name: persistent_type_specificity
comparisons.view: Seven common resolved broad types with at least 300 cells at every stage
comparisons.effect: At each stage, mean log1p(CP10k) in the leading type minus the second-highest type; equal type weighting avoids file composition weights
comparisons.support: Same leading type at all five stages, minimum gap >= 0.4 log units, minimum detection in that type >= 0.10
comparisons.counter: Leader changes, gap shrinks, or detection becomes sparse
comparisons.interpretation: Persistent relative cell-type association in these files, not constant expression or a reason for official panel inclusion

comparisons.name: within_type_stage_association
comparisons.view: Resolved broad type with >=500 cells at all five stages; published X and detected-gene-quartile equal-weight sensitivity
comparisons.effect: Spearman correlation of five stage ranks with type-conditional mean log1p(CP10k), and five-stage range; detection and positive intensity tracked separately
comparisons.support: Absolute rank correlation >=0.9, equal-weight range >=0.5 log units, same direction after detection-stratum equal weighting, minimum absolute leave-one-stage rank correlation >=0.8, detection >=0.10 at one stage
comparisons.counter: Sign changes under quality equal weighting or the pattern is driven by one isolated stage
comparisons.interpretation: Candidate stage association among five released specimens, not an embryo-replicated developmental trajectory

comparisons.name: within_type_spatial_localization
comparisons.view: Within each specimen and resolved broad type with >=500 cells; XY quadrants x z quartiles in that file only
comparisons.effect: Fraction of log-expression residual variance attributable to the 16 candidate spatial blocks after raw fine-label and detected-gene quartile adjustment; nearest same-type within-slice residual correlation minus same-slice raw-label random-neighbor correlation
comparisons.support: Block eta squared >=0.03 and fine-neighbor correlation gain >=0.05 in at least two stages of the same broad type, with gene detection >=0.10 and at least 50 cells in the peak block; the peak-block minimum was added during derivation
comparisons.counter: Adjustment removes regional effect, nearest neighbors resemble matched random cells, or signal appears in only one stage
comparisons.interpretation: Recurrent local organization within type; coordinate frames are unregistered, so location is not carried across stages

technical_checks: Each input SHA-256 matches config.json before read
Count-layer contrast direction shown separately from normalized contrast
All 500 measured genes retained in ledger, including genes with insufficient support
No cell-level developmental p values or pathway activity labels
